About us

Context from Japan, in clear English.

Japan Daily Brief is an English-language publication explaining the news, culture, language, and daily life shaping Japan. We are built for international readers who want to understand why a story matters—not simply receive another translated headline.

Yuji Shimizu · YUJI @ Japan

Yuji is the publisher and a writer for Japan Daily Brief. His work connects Japanese places, everyday culture, language learning, and digital storytelling. He is also the creator of DraMap, a role-playing Japanese-learning app.

Editorial standards

  • We distinguish reported facts, analysis, and opinion.
  • We link to primary documents and reliable reporting wherever possible.
  • We write original summaries and do not republish news articles or unlicensed photography.
  • We publish dates, author names, corrections, and material updates.
  • Automated tools may assist research and drafting, but publication remains editorially accountable to the publisher.

Ownership and commercial disclosure

Japan Daily Brief is owned and operated by Yuji Shimizu. Yuji also creates DraMap. References and promotional placements for DraMap are therefore house advertising, not independent third-party endorsements. News selection and factual sourcing are kept separate from promotional claims.
